title: Human Detection in Restricted Zones
tagline: Notices the moment someone strays off the designated path.

meta.description: Notices the moment someone strays off the designated path.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Unauthorized entry into restricted zones is a real risk in plants, airports, and secure sites, and manual monitoring is easy to defeat by accident or oversight.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Real-time human detection tracks movement patterns and flags anomalies, feeding straight into automated alerts or deterrents.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Fewer unauthorized entries and a clearer picture of movement patterns across the site.
